ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 8:1 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark pigmentation field (base pixel intensity < 50) punctuated by high-intensity (intensity > 200) linear and curvilinear streaks (rake marks) and circular/elliptical high-contrast blobs concentrated heavily at the lateral tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; the vertex is partially obscured by water spray, but the interior angle of the visible lobe boundaries is approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks ranges from 2 to 10 pixels; pattern is continuous across both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curves; the right lobe exhibits a more pronounced upward vertical sweep at its distal tip compared to the left lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-intensity circular pixel groups located on the leading and trailing edges of the lateral fluke tips, corresponding to barnacle attachment points and subsequent scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (1-5 pixels in width) cross-hatching the dark pigmentation of both lobes, particularly dense on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Evidence of significant ectoparasitic load (barnacles) visible as raised, high-intensity textured clusters on the fluke tips; extensive scarring from rake marks across the central and lateral areas.
